content: This paper presents a novel method for joint feature selection and classification of longitudinal functional data with categorical outcomes, combining logistic loss and functional features within a new optimization framework. By using functional principal components and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm, the approach efficiently handles high-dimensional data and identifies key features, with strong performance shown in simulations and a real-world study on chronic diseases and socio-demographic factors.
